subject: Renewal + Upsell: billing route, PO, and tax docs for HollowTech
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hollowtech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + Upsell: billing route, PO, and tax docs for HollowTech

Hi Elena,

Congrats on the approval — excited to get HollowTech renewed and add the extra 200 seats you mentioned. For the renewal amendment we need to confirm a few billing items so our finance team can generate an invoice that matches your internal routing: 

- Desired payor entity (current invoice goes to HollowTech, LLC). You mentioned a separate EU entity during procurement — is that still required for this renewal?
- PO number to put on the invoice (we can accept a PO after we issue a draft invoice).
- Net terms: current contract is Net30. Are you requesting Net45 for the renewed term?
- Tax paperwork: if invoicing to an EU entity we typically need VAT/EORI or W8/W9 equivalents for cross-border accounting.

I've attached the latest renewal quote (HollowTech_Renewal_Quote_v3.pdf) that includes the seat uplift and the proposed prorated month for the add-on. If you can confirm the payor entity and provide the procurement PO (or let us know who to loop in at procurement@hollowtech.com), we'll stamp the PO number on the invoice and route it to the right payor.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: HollowTech_Renewal_Quote_v3.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hollowtech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@hollowtech.com
Date: 2028-05-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Upsell: billing route, PO, and tax docs for HollowTech

Diego —

Thanks for the quote. We're good to proceed with the renewal and the 200-seat add; procurement asked that the invoices for this contract be issued to HollowTech EU (our EU legal entity) rather than HollowTech, LLC. They also prefer Net45 on the renewal invoice.

I've attached our W-9 copy for the US entity in case you need it for your records, but procurement will provide the EU VAT registration and EORI if you insist on those for invoicing to the EU entity.

Procurement contact is: Elena Ruiz / procurement@hollowtech.com.

Please generate a draft invoice showing:
- Payor: HollowTech EU
- PO: HOLD-2028-331 (procurement will confirm formally but wanted to give you the placeholder)
- Net45 terms

Once we see the draft, procurement will route a formal PO and sign the amendment.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, HollowTech
elena.ruiz@hollowtech.com
Attachment: HollowTech_W9.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hollowtech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance@hollowtech.com>
Date: 2028-05-13T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Upsell: billing route, PO, and tax docs for HollowTech

Thanks Elena — that helps. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side: 

1) We can invoice HollowTech EU and set Net45.
2) We'll include the placeholder PO (HOLD-2028-331) on the draft invoice; please have procurement confirm the final PO number when available.
3) Our finance team needs either the EU VAT/EORI or confirmation that HollowTech EU is VAT-registered so we can suppress US tax withholding, otherwise they ask for the W-9 we received.

Monica — can your team prepare a draft invoice showing the payor switch to "HollowTech EU", Net45 terms, the seat uplift line, and the placeholder PO? I attached our invoice template (redwood-invoice-template.xlsx) for reference — feel free to populate and send back for Elena/procurement sign-off.

Karthik — we may need a one-off amendment to the Master Services Agreement to reflect the added seats and the payor swap; can you own a quick draft SOW amendment and share with Monica for inclusion in the invoice packet?

Elena — once we have the confirmed PO and EU tax evidence we can send the formal invoice and DocuSign amendment.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (XLSX, 65KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hollowtech.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance@hollowtech.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Upsell: billing route, PO, and tax docs for HollowTech

On Tue, 2028-05-13 at 08:15, Diego Fernandez wrote:
> Monica — can your team prepare a draft invoice showing the payor switch to "HollowTech EU", Net45 terms, the seat uplift line, and the placeholder PO? I attached our invoice template (redwood-invoice-template.xlsx) for reference — feel free to populate and send back for Elena/procurement sign-off.

Hi Elena — looping in Redwood Finance to confirm we've captured everything. Per Diego's note, we've prepared a draft invoice and a short SOW amendment to reflect the uplift and payor swap. Attached: SOW_amendment_Draft.docx and populated invoice PDF draft (we exported the template to PDF for review).

Summary of actions taken:
- Draft invoice set to: Payor = HollowTech EU; Terms = Net45; PO field = HOLD-2028-331 (please confirm final PO)
- Seat uplift line included (200 seats, prorated to renewal start date)
- Requested EU VAT/EORI evidence from procurement to finalize tax handling
- SOW amendment in draft form; Karthik will tidy language on the payor clause and send final version to DocuSign.

Next asks for procurement to close: 
1) Confirm final PO number to replace the placeholder.
2) Share EU VAT/EORI (or confirmation of VAT registration).
3) Confirm invoice payee details (company name, billing address, AP contact + email).

Once those items are received we will issue the formal invoice and route AMENDMENT via DocuSign.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOW_amendment_Draft.docx (DOCX, 32KB); invoice_draft_HollowTech_EU.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
